goal: Owner clarifications after run-20261030-074412-044b: (1) strict record declarations — a trailing-slash entry is a directory, a bare entry is an exact file path, never a directory found on disk — at every record-matching site, the late-eyes diff composed from candidate file paths, verified on real git output; (2) vendor hacheong's reviewed hostcall.py (7aa70c6, sha256 fa06077c...) with adapter tests; (3) review and adopt the owner-authorized prior documentation/Python-floor/AGENTS work and the portable bootstrap environment with prior-work provenance, and classify dropping supported Python or host versions as MAJOR in Versioning
brief: Correct raw-build's dwitbuk.py to Q-bounded (read that section and the two paragraphs it supersedes). (1) Restore the generic git(target, *args) helper to its previous semantics exactly (text with universal newlines, as at 39e2a7b), and add a narrowly named patch helper git_patch(target, *args) — git's stdout decoded as UTF-8 with errors replaced, no newline translation, None on a non-zero exit — used only by path_diff's content diff calls. (2) Bounded work: once the composed text has passed its limit (80000 for the eyes diff, 40000 for excluded_diff), invoke no later git diff batch and keep no later patch; cut at the limit and keep the truncation declared. (3) Keep git's own order within a batch; across batches UU combined sections may follow batch order (documented limit). (4) Keep everything else: DU/UD '* Unmerged path' lines as their path's own section in every position, a lone \r neither starting nor ending a section, explicit failure on unattributable output before any packet is written, exact attribution, no declared record's section, no repeated section, the canonical diff flags, an oversized path alone in its call. test_dwitbuk.py is the contract and protected: do not edit it, hooks/, README.md, the manifests, eyes_worker.py or hostcall.py, and do not commit. Run the suite as env -u AGENT_WORKER python3 test_dwitbuk.py.

built.summary: Updated dwitbuk.py for Q-bounded: restored universal-newline git(), added git_patch(), bounded diff batching, and preserved git’s within-batch order. Full suite passed.
non-claims: Replaced the prior implementation’s global raw reads and cross-batch sorting as Q-bounded requires. Protected tests and other files were not edited.

rb-tests: The amended order test (item 3, 'when the text is not cut every kept section is present exactly once with all its source content') passes on the current tree: it is a relaxation of a test that already passed, so it cannot fail before the build.

'Patches of batches not yet needed are never kept' is decided only by observation at subprocess.run: a build that runs later batches through another path (Popen, os.system) and throws them away would get past the call count. No test can see memory that is kept and then dropped.

'used only by path_diff's content diff calls': the tests check that eyes-request content calls go through git_patch and that injecting at git_patch reaches both eyes request and excluded_diff. No test checks that no other caller uses git_patch.

The cap tests compare the decoded stdout length of each git diff call with the limit. That equals the composed text only when no section is filtered out, which holds in these fixtures (no declared record among the paths in the eyes test; all records in the excluded test).

'Unexpected output fails explicitly before any packet is written' and the Q-git-config canonical flags are decided by the existing tests, now pointed at git_patch. The git-config tests themselves were not changed.
